reasoning: This is a fork of Kubeflow Pipelines — a multi-component ML pipeline orchestration service that runs on Kubernetes. It includes a Go backend with API server, driver, launcher, persistence agent, and scheduled workflow controller (each with its own Dockerfile), a React frontend, a Python SDK, protobuf-based API definitions, and Kustomize deployment manifests. It is a deployable service platform, not an operator (no CRD controllers extending the Kubernetes API), not a library (it is a full application with backend, frontend, and deployment manifests), and not configuration. The project provides end-to-end ML pipeline orchestration: compiling pipeline definitions, scheduling and running workflows via Argo Workflows, storing metadata, and serving a web UI.
